agent_explanation: Controller force is correctly clamped to fmax≈59.98 at steps 58-59 while chasing waypoint, but jumps to 163.22 at step 60 exactly when bodies 0 and 1 collide (touching_pairs gap 0.00034). The velocity of body 0 changes discontinuously due to collision impulse (speed 12.14->12.64 and vx -12.14->-12.40), and the controller recomputes force from the post-collision velocity error without re-applying the fmax clamp (or adds an impulse-compensation term that exceeds fmax). Substeps_in_step=15 indicates the violation occurs inside substepped integration where clamping is bypassed.
